decisions.note: Round 1: maker's clarifying menu + 'sensible default' (single-user web app, tags, FTS, auto-fetch title/description, JSON import/export) never surfaced snapshotting, Internet-Archive backup, bundles, bulk actions, sort keys, tag autocomplete, boolean/#tag/phrase search syntax, markdown note rendering, manual-resave dedup-to-edit, or Netscape-HTML export; client just said 'go ahead' with no extend request, so these stayed unaddressed through the whole session (satisficing miss).

Round 2 delivery substitutes a 'Favorites' star/filter (not a reference concept) where the reference requires distinct unread/read-later and reversible-archive states; client's reaction ('exactly what I had in mind') affirms the build without noticing unread/archive are missing — satisficing miss.

End of round 2 the maker offered alternatives (browser-bookmarks HTML import / dead-link check / bulk tag editing); client selected HTML import, which matches the reference's Netscape-HTML import requirement, over the non-reference dead-link-check option — caught via select, implemented in round 3.
